title: Return to DeLisa, a trip to New York and Eddie Cole's band
summary: After the 5100 Club she went back to DeLisa, with a New York visit between; they wonder whether King Cole played with Eddie Cole.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Yeah, Nettie can tell you. Yeah. Mm-hmm. And when I left there, I went back to Love to Lisa.
How long were you at 5100, I suppose? Or was that also in and out?
Well, yes, because I was there, I guess... Let's see. I was there about two or three months or something like that, and I left and went to New York and came back. Did you work in New York?

No, I didn't work in New York. I went there to visit my mother-in-law, my husband's mother. Mm-hmm. And, uh, came back and I went back to there. So when I left Love to Lisa, I went back there. That was the second time I went back there.
You said Horace Henderson was the first band? No. Eddie Cole. Eddie Cole was the first band then.
I don't know. I don't know. I didn't know how I was heard of the same. Mm-hmm.
Was, uh, uh, King Cole with Eddie at that time?

There is some rumor that he may have played on some early records of Eddie Cole. They were made about that time. Eddie Cole also was a piano player, wasn't he? Oh, yes. That's the reason why Nat should have played piano for him.
